notes.title: Update #1 - Broken Achievement Fixed!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It has come to my notice that "Got a Gold Medal" achievement was not unlocking so I fixed the issue and pushed an update. It should now work as intended. I am sorry for the inconvenience caused because of it. Please feel free to let me know if you encounter any further issue. 

Any feedback is greatly appreciated! Thank you for taking your time to check this game out! I hope you will enjoy it.

Happy Gaming!

Best Regards,
Anamik
